Q1: Boron sodium oxide pentahydrate exhibits known significant hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive toxicity (CMR1) and organ/systemic effects (OGN1) based on official classifications. Although oral exposure (ORL3) shows a demonstrated low to moderate hazard, there is insufficient data to confidently assess its environmental (ENV4) and endocrine disruption (EDC4) hazards.

Q3: While boron sodium oxide pentahydrate has a specific molecular formula (B4Na2O7.5H2O) and 325 scientific literature references, which is a moderate level of study within the dataset of fracking and petrochemical materials, its classification as 'Manual Registration' suggests it is not as comprehensively defined as many other chemicals.
